lane: arm64 transition candidate 1.2.0 built from this lock against the unchanged upstream pin; the published 1.1.1 riscv64 record and its bytes are preserved unchanged

upstream.commitSubject: Fix: judge only plain radius lengths, not math-function operands (#1168) (#1171)
upstream.pinAuthority: floe-skill-hub docs/UPSTREAM-PINS.json (reviewBaselineDate 2026-10-26); unchanged from the 1.1.1 lineage
upstream.skillEnginePairing: the skill package under sources/impeccable and every engine artifact are produced from this one commit

earlierObservedCommit.relation: verified ancestor of the pin, two commits behind, same ENGINE_VERSION; not used to build any artifact

floe.license: MPL-2.0 for Floe-authored adapter files; upstream crates keep Apache-2.0
floe.identityGate: the adapter crate Cargo.toml version is the single component version constant; build/build_engine.py derives the receipt, dist directory name and the contract engine identity from it and refuses to compile on any drift
adapterChangesFrom1.1.1: adapter/src/error.rs runtime_execution_state gains the aarch64-linux branch so the shipped arm64 guest artifact self-describes as aarch64-linux instead of host-comparison-build
adapter/tests/contract_embedded.rs and adapter/tests/snapshot_scan.rs pinned 1.1.1 literals move to 1.2.0

adapter/tools/sync_contract_identity.py substitutes through a function so the engine-probe stdout's literal backslash-n JSON escape is not rewritten as a real newline (latent re-template escape bug, found while bumping this candidate)
adapter/tests/data expected-* goldens keep their recorded 1.1.0 identity: normalize() strips engineId/adapter version before golden comparison and they are deliberate pre-patch references

vendoring: the full upstream source tree is never committed to this repository; build_engine.py exports it from the pinned commit into task scratch, applies the tracked patches and stages the tracked adapter crate

toolchain.zigRole: C compiler and linker driver for the aarch64 musl target only; the engine dependency graph is pure Rust after patch 0001, so no C or assembly is compiled

aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.purpose: the Floe Linux ARM64 guest (Debian 13 arm64 userland on the App-owned ARM64 VM; TinyEMU riscv64 is superseded for this transition round)
aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.linkage: static (crt-static, Rust self-contained musl runtime disabled in favour of the zig musl sysroot startup files); no dynamic loader or glibc version dependency
aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.guestExecution: pending; a static ABI check and any host-side emulated run are not guest execution and must not be claimed as such

aarch64-apple-darwin.purpose: host behavioral comparison and the adapter test suite; never shipped as the guest engine

excludedUpstreamCrates.impeccable-browser: Chromium/CDP URL engine; forbidden for a native page scan
excludedUpstreamCrates.impeccable-skills: install/update/check/link with ring signature verification; the Floe Skill Hub owns installation
excludedUpstreamCrates.impeccable-comp: comp-fidelity raster/font libraries used by the CDP capture verbs
excludedUpstreamCrates.impeccable-cli: the upstream verb router; replaced by the Floe router

component.evidence: FACTS.json + dist/ receipt in this private scope; no publication, no App, no guest claim
